| base report input encode cases arithmetic |
base := '/opt/git/BenjaVisionPro/catalyst-workspace/Magritte/magritte-cpp/conformance/'.
report := [ CCNativeMcpLease forRunningServers during: [
input := NeoJSONReader fromString: '{"fractions":[[-9223372036854775808,1],[-10001,100],[-1,1000],[0,1],[1,1000],[1,10],[1,2],[10001,100],[9223372036854775807,1],[1,9223372036854775807]],"others":[{"type":"integer","value":"-9223372036854775808"},{"type":"integer","value":"-1"},{"type":"integer","value":"0"},{"type":"integer","value":"1"},{"type":"integer","value":"100"},{"type":"integer","value":"9223372036854775807"},{"type":"float","value":"3fb999999999999a"},{"type":"float","value":"3fe0000000000000"},{"type":"float","value":"bfb999999999999a"},{"type":"float","value":"bfe0000000000000"},{"type":"float","value":"01a56e1fc2f8f359"},{"type":"float","value":"7e37e43c8800759c"},{"type":"float","value":"fe37e43c8800759c"}]}'.
encode := [ :v | v isInteger ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'integer'. 'value' -> v asString } ] ifFalse: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'fraction'. 'value' -> (Dictionary newFrom: { 'numerator' -> v numerator asString. 'denominator' -> v denominator asString }) } ] ].
cases := OrderedCollection new.
(input at: 'fractions') do: [ :pair | | left | left := pair first / pair second.
 (input at: 'others') do: [ :j | | right | right := (j at: 'type') = 'integer' ifTrue: [ (j at: 'value') asInteger ] ifFalse: [ Float fromIEEE64Bit: (Integer readFrom: (j at: 'value') base: 16) ].
 cases add: (Dictionary newFrom: { 'left' -> (encode value: left). 'right' -> j. 'equal' -> (left = right). 'less' -> (left < right). 'greater' -> (left > right) }) ] ].
arithmetic := { {100. 10}. {100. 20}. {10001/100. 30}. {-100. -10}. {0. 1}. {100. 0} } collect: [ :pair | Dictionary newFrom: { 'parent' -> (encode value: pair first). 'child' -> (encode value: pair second). 'result' -> (encode value: pair first + (pair second / 1000)) } ].
Dictionary newFrom: { 'comparisons' -> cases asArray. 'arithmetic' -> arithmetic }
] ] ensure: [ (base, 'builders-priorities-mcp-gate.json') asFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :s | s truncate; nextPutAll: '{"complete":true,"nativeResources":false}' ] ].
(base, 'builders-priorities-reference.json') asFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :s | s truncate; nextPutAll: (NeoJSONWriter toStringPretty: report) ].
(report at: 'comparisons') size
